text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez, happy birthday! Happy, happy
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I appreciate it, Teio. Amidst the
many well
wishes I've received, your
straightforward
sincerity resonates the
loudest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Um, Prez? Recently, I've been thinking
about a
lot of stuff. Like what would've
happened if you'd
never been born...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Like, would I still be who I am today?
You've
been my motivation from the
start, so without
you, I don't think I'd be
here, either.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm sure you would have been fine

regardless. Umamusume are guided by
their
destinies, flowing ever forward like
a rushing
river.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Both you and I stem from the source of
that river,
and the flowing lineage of
emperors and
monarchs will not dry up
so easily. That is, as long
as we hold on
to our dreams.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
As long as we hold on to our dreams...
You
mean...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, one day our successors will

appear—those who we inspire and pass
on the
torch to.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Teio, there is one thing I wish to ask of
you. Can
you promise to keep navigating
this immemorial
stream of fate with me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I promise, Prez! And someday,
we'll entrust
our Triple Crown dream to
the next generation!
